subject.title: build(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: Should completed exact-head Android build and test output, attached as redacted evidence, be accepted as sufficient compatibility proof for this Dependabot Kotlin compiler-plugin update?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes the compiler plugins used by multiple Android targets and the external bot PR contains no after-change proof; a maintainer must set the acceptable evidence threshold.

options.title: Require completed Android matrix evidence
options.body: Wait for the current head's Play, Wear, and third-party Android jobs to pass and record concise redacted output before merging.

options.title: Accept the upgrade with CI-only confidence
options.body: Merge once required checks are green without requesting an attached proof artifact, accepting the remaining compiler-plugin compatibility uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require completed Android matrix evidence
recommendation.body: Wait for the current head's Play, Wear, and third-party Android jobs to pass and record concise redacted output before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline is the only concrete routing signal for this Android dependency update.
